page_title: CM-M - Dooku vs Anakin (SW Ep. III) - SaberCraft
prose: In this tutorial, you’ll learn CM-M, a dynamic sequence inspired by the duel between Count Dooku and Anakin Skywalker in Star Wars: Episode III – Revenge of the Sith. This reproduction is built around constant attack, response, and directional inversion. Unlike earlier patterns where the defender blocks or dodges while retreating, CM-M flips the exchange: the defender advances, closes distance, and turns defense into forward pressure. This is the first CM where the direction of the attack is fully inverted.
